name: Sudoku
author: Azdren Ymeri (generator and solver), NucleoOS (touch UI)
description: Endless Sudoku in three levels: a fresh puzzle every time, clashes shown in red, timer and best times, the game kept when you leave. Touch or keyboard.

descriptions.en: Endless Sudoku in three levels: a fresh puzzle every time, clashes shown in red, timer and best times, the game kept when you leave. Touch or keyboard.
descriptions.it: Sudoku infinito in tre livelli: uno schema nuovo ogni volta, conflitti in rosso, cronometro e record, la partita resta salvata quando esci. Touch o tastiera.
